get.description: Reads the newest published daily snapshot only. Requests never call the provider and never substitute a rate of 1. A pair with no usable snapshot returns 200 with status "unavailable" and a reason.

ClerkSession.description: Paste a short-lived Clerk session token, not a backend API key. Scalar does not sign in or refresh tokens.

APIVersion.name: X-Ledger-API-Version
APIVersion.description: Exact contract date. Missing, malformed and retired dates are rejected before authentication.

base_currency.description: Required on first initialization: uppercase ISO 4217 code.

timezone.description: Required on first initialization: IANA timezone, excluding Local.

locale.description: Required on first initialization: BCP 47 language tag.

BootstrapInput.description: All three values are required only for a new identity. Existing identities may send an empty body or any supported initialization fields; stored settings are never overwritten. This database-dependent rule is enforced by the service.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, excluding Local. Null is ignored.

theme.description: system, light or dark. Null is ignored.

PreferencesPatch.description: At least one non-null field is required; validation is performed by the service.

Currency.description: Language-neutral accounting metadata. Localized display labels are provided by the versioned CLDR reference pack.

EntryInput.description: Amounts are exact decimal strings in each account currency. Transfers require destination account and principal; income/expense require category; refunds require original_id and retain its category. The service enforces type-dependent fields, active references, precision and refund limits.

CorrectionInput.description: Absent entry explicitly voids the transaction. Present entry replaces the entire business input. Selected directly related fees are corrected/voided atomically; omitted fees remain independent.

provider_filter.description: Provider filter recorded on the published snapshot.

pivot.description: Snapshot base currency used for exact cross-rate derivation.

rate.description: Reference rate display value: the provider decimal for a direct quote, otherwise half-even rounded to at most 18 significant digits.

numerator.description: Exact rate numerator as an integer string.

denominator.description: Exact rate denominator as an integer string.

derived.description: How the rate was produced: direct, inverse or cross.

rate_date.description: Earliest effective date among the snapshot legs actually used.

snapshot_date.description: UTC date of the snapshot batch that was read.

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 time the snapshot was fetched from the provider.

latest_snapshot_date.description: UTC date of the newest published snapshot, when any exists.

reason.description: Why the rate is unavailable: no_snapshot or pair_unavailable.
